accuracy_notes: Backlog, Screen, Research, Co-design and archived design metadata was treated as source-readiness evidence only and never as absence of a constraint or a parcel result.
Historic-landfill evidence identified as conditional and time-limited was not copied into or used for commercial parcel scoring.
National Grid cable information identified as indicative and non-commercial was not used for cable alignment, easement, clearance or parcel scoring.
The empty COMAH platform dataset was retained as a coverage gap and never interpreted as absence of COMAH sites or consultation requirements.
Permitted-development categories were not treated as site eligibility or permission evidence; historical Part 22 examples were explicitly rejected for current use.
Brownfield register narratives were not promoted without exact canonical parcel linkage, current implementation, condition and remediation evidence.
No parcel relation, future-growth score or business row was fabricated.
